items.title: Ethereum Foundation backs Keccak-256 to counter quantum, AI threats
items.body: Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma told Cointelegraph that AI poses a more immediate threat as Ethereum prepares for one of its biggest security overhauls since the Merge.

items.title: Morning Minute: Ethereum Focuses on Security As AI Threats Rise
items.body: The Ethereum Foundation pulls its quantum-resistance deadline forward to end 2028, as AI labs say their next models are too dangerous.

items.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
items.body: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

items.title: What the CFTC’s New Crypto Reserves Guidance Actually Allows—And What It Doesn’t
items.body: Staff guidance lets swap venues and clearinghouses count Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins toward their 12-month operating-cost buffer. Here's the catch.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
items.body: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.
